title: Native IFC/openBIM interoperability on the verified CAD/BIM product
objective: Turn the already-earned RESEARCH-CAD-003 semantic evidence into the first production IFC/openBIM interoperability workflow on the verified CAD/BIM product, without making IfcOpenShell or IFC files canonical: Offisos BIM -> IFC export -> external IFC -> IFC import -> semantic reconciliation -> canonical Offisos BIM -> Construction Graph. Canonical element identity is preserved (IFC GlobalIds retained only as provenance), units and placements are normalized, loss/unsupported fields are reported explicitly, controlled mutations survive the round trip and identify exactly the changed canonical elements, IDS/BCF interoperate through the proven research toolchain, and Web/Electron produce equivalent semantic results through the shared App API.
acceptance_criteria: A representative Offisos BIM model exports to IFC with required semantic classes/properties/relationships preserved (walls, slabs, openings, doors/windows, spaces, stories; identity psets, quantities, containment/aggregation/voids/fills relationships).
A representative IFC model imports into canonical Offisos BIM elements with stable canonical IDs and IFC GlobalIds retained only as provenance (engineId).
Export -> import semantic comparison reports exact/declared-tolerance preservation for supported fields and explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED results for unsupported fields.
Units and placements survive the round trip with declared tolerances (IFC length-unit normalization to canonical mm; story-local placement reconstruction).
Controlled model mutations survive the IFC round trip and identify exactly which canonical elements changed (field-level reconciliation by canonical identity).
IDS validation can be invoked through the existing supported toolchain (IfcTester), and validation failures are represented explicitly, bound to canonical element provenance.
BCF topic/reference contracts bind issues to canonical element provenance without making BCF the system of record (references resolve back to canonical IDs).
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic results through the shared App API (identical export artifacts/hashes and reconciliation reports through the real transports).
Existing CAD, BIM, documentation, Graph and real-engine suites remain green (no regression).
No direct IfcOpenShell imports occur in renderer/CADDocument/App API; IFC engine work remains inside adapter/worker boundaries (LOCK-018 scan extended to the IFC core).
IFC version/file provenance and deterministic import records are persisted (versioned, replayable, save/open-stable).
No protected architecture files are modified.
non_goals: IFC4x3 parity beyond the explicitly supported subset.
Native IFC editing UI for every schema entity.
Project/scheduling work (explicitly deferred by the Architect).
Making IFC or IfcOpenShell the canonical model or the Construction Graph (adapter/worker boundaries stay; GlobalIds are provenance only).
Approval or verification claim by implementation.
risk_assumptions: Issue #47 (scope) + the execution release comment 5434489016 are the authoritative scope. Requirement mapping is clean this slice: IFC-001 (import/export through an adapter with semantic fidelity thresholds) + IFC-002 (IDS/BCF/openBIM pathways) + BIM-002 (BIM semantics independent of editor implementation).

The record declares exactly the issue's dependencies (both VERIFIED on main 56de6f32); RESEARCH-CAD-003 (VERIFIED) is consumed as evidence/toolchain provenance, not silently added as a dependency.

DIVERGENCE FLAG (pre-existing debt, not this slice): COMPAT-CAD-001 record still PR_OPEN on main (PR #38 merged at 9b27d16) - architect-side close-out debt, fourth consecutive slice; flagged for the Architect.

Toolchain pins follow RESEARCH-CAD-003's proven requirements: ifcopenshell==0.8.5, IfcTester==0.8.5 (which provides bcf-client 0.8.5), numpy==2.1.3. Known broken distributions are excluded (PyPI ifcopenshell-ids 0.8.0 corrupts ifcopenshell 0.8.5; PyPI bcf 1.9.1 is unrelated firmware tooling).

Deterministic export is a designed invariant, not an accident: fixed IFC header timestamp, fixed entity creation order, and deterministic IfcGuid derivation (canonical-id-derived GlobalIds for products, STEP-id-keyed SHA-256 normalization for non-product roots) make the exported IFC bytes byte-identical across runs and hosts. The canonical semantic IR (with content hash) remains the reconciliation artifact regardless.

Import fidelity is explicit: fields the source IFC cannot supply are classified LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED in the import report, never silently approximated; the only caller-declared fallback is an explicit import option (e.g. default story height for external files lacking storey height), recorded in the report as a declared approximation.

Geometry fidelity scope: the export uses the research-proven representation recipes (wall/slab/footprint/extrusion profiles); the import reconstructs canonical parameters from placements + profile dimensions + standard attributes. Arbitrary external IFC geometry beyond these shapes is classified UNSUPPORTED per element - honest limits, no silent guessing.

LOCK-018 forbidden-import scan extended to src/ifc. Toolchain-absent environments skip the IFC tests with recorded reasons (verified: 2 pass + 14 skip + 0 fail with a broken python).

Electron typecheck/build clean + smoke:ifc 12/12 PASS (probe/export/determinism/compare/import/mutation-identification/atomic-undo/IDS-flip/BCF/records/save-open identity) + all seven regression smokes green (smoke, geometry on the real OCCT engine, model, impact, drafting, bim, docs).

evidence_requirements: Deterministic IFC export/import tests on the real ifcopenshell 0.8.5 toolchain: export byte-determinism, semantic IR content hashes, identity pset preservation, units/placement normalization within declared tolerances.
Round-trip semantic comparison evidence: export -> import reports exact/declared-tolerance preservation for supported fields and explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED classification for unsupported fields.

IDS/BCF evidence through the proven toolchain: per-entity validation results bound to canonical provenance; BCF topic/reference round trips resolving to canonical element IDs.
Persistence evidence: deterministic import records survive save/open with identical content/history hashes; import/reconciliation flows through the versioned command model (immutable, replayable).
Web and Electron host parity through the shared App API and the real transports (identical export hashes and reconciliation reports).

Existing CAD, drafting, BIM, documentation, Graph and real-engine suites remain green; LOCK-018 forbidden-import scan extended to the IFC core (no IfcOpenShell imports outside adapter/worker boundaries).
